notif.title: Notifications
notif.subtitle: System alerts in the app and on your devices
notif.empty_hint: Alerts about lots, orders and reservations will show up here.
notif.clear_read_confirm: Delete the notifications you have already read?
notif.device_hint: Get alerts as phone or desktop notifications even when the app is closed.
notif.state_denied: Blocked by the browser. Allow them in the site settings (lock icon next to the address) and come back.
notif.state_unsupported: This browser does not support push notifications. Try Chrome, Edge or Firefox.
notif.state_dev: Push notifications only work in the published build (not in development mode).
notif.state_ios: On iPhone and iPad, install the app first: Share → “Add to Home Screen”; then open it from the icon and turn them on here.
notif.state_insecure: Notifications and installing require a secure connection (https) or opening the system on “localhost”.
notif.disabled_ok: Notifications turned off on this device
notif.denied_toast: The browser did not grant permission
notif.not_ready_toast: The browser was still preparing the app to receive alerts. Wait a few seconds and press “Turn on” again.
notif.test_none: You have no devices with notifications turned on
notif.test_failed: The test could not be delivered ({{failed}} of {{devices}} devices)
notif.devices_hint: Alerts reach all of these devices. Remove the ones you no longer use.
notif.devices_none: No device has notifications turned on.
notif.prefs_hint: Only alerts that match your permissions are listed. You are not notified about what you do yourself.

ev.lot_counted_desc: A lot is ready to move to testing.
ev.lot_testing_desc: A lot moved to testing and its units can be registered.
ev.order_completed_desc: An order or a quick sale was completed.
ev.order_cancelled_desc: An order was cancelled (including ones you created).
ev.order_expiring_desc: A reservation expires in less than 24 hours.
ev.order_expired_desc: A reservation expired and its units were released.

pwa.install_hint: Open it like any other app, with its own icon and no browser bar.
pwa.installed: The app is already installed on this device.
pwa.install_ios: On iPhone and iPad: tap Share, then “Add to Home Screen”.
pwa.install_manual: Use the browser menu and choose “Install app” (or “Add to Home Screen”).
pwa.offline: Offline. You can keep working across the whole app: what you do is saved on this device and sent when you're back.
pwa.unreachable_hint: Check your internet connection. Your session is kept: it will resume by itself when the connection is back.
